reviews.author: Laura Seep
reviews.text:
The best fried empanadas I've had in Sierra de la Ventana! 🥟❤️
Excellent service, very friendly! A pleasure to buy from there! 🥟❤️

Absolutely delicious. The dough was golden brown, crispy, and not heavy at all, and the filling was super generous, flavorful, and well-seasoned. You can tell they're made with care and good ingredients.

I tried several empanadas in Sierra de la Ventana, but these were, without a doubt, the best I bought. 😍

Highly recommended! If you're visiting Sierra de la Ventana, don't leave without trying them. 👏🥟

reviews.author: José Luis Pedretti
reviews.text:
Excellent service! We went for the weekend. The owner is very friendly. The pizzas were delicious, and the ingredients were clearly high quality.
Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jorge G.
reviews.text: Excellent service and helpful staff. They made us delicious fried empanadas right there. They also have pasta and other quick meals. Highly recommended.
